title: skillpack models file (skillpack.models.json)
description: The concrete model used on this machine for each model name a pack's agents ask for. Lives at the project root and is not committed (skillpack lists it in .git/info/exclude).

$schema.description: Schema URL. Its /v<N>/ folder sets the format version; a file without $schema is read as v1.

packs.description: Model mappings per pack, keyed by the same normalized source as in skillpack.json.

additionalProperties.description: Model mappings for one pack, keyed by the harness-neutral model name the pack's agents ask for.

opencode.description: OpenCode model as provider/model, without a variant.
